name: QuickQuote
tagline: Price a driveway job on your phone, in the driveway.
audience: Sealing, line painting and pressure-washing contractors
before: The estimate gets worked out on paper or in your head, then typed up again at night. Prices drift from job to job and the customer waits a day for a number.
after: Pick the service, enter the measurements, and get a clean quote with your own prices while you are still standing in the driveway.

screenshot.alt: QuickQuote on a phone: a 60 by 12 foot driveway with seal coat and 40 feet of crack sealing comes to a quote of $510, with a $153 deposit to schedule.
screenshot.caption: A real quote: a 60 by 12 foot driveway, seal coat and crack sealing.

steps.title: Pick the service
steps.text: Sealing and repair, line painting, or pressure washing.

steps.title: Enter the size
steps.text: Length and width, plus cracks, potholes or edges if the job has them.

steps.title: Text the quote
steps.text: The total, the deposit and every line item, ready to send before you get back in the truck.

origin: Built first for Seals Go Pro, a driveway sealing business. Type your own business name in Settings.
built_with: One web page, built with AI. Works on a phone.
